scripts.start:backend: concurrently "npm run start:gateway" "npm run start:user" "npm run start:task" "npm run start:notification"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend/api-gateway && npm install && cd ../services/user-service && npm install && cd ../task-service && npm install && cd ../notification-service && npm install && cd ../../frontend/shell-app && npm install
scripts.install:backend: npm install && cd backend/api-gateway && npm install && cd ../services/user-service && npm install && cd ../task-service && npm install && cd ../notification-service && npm install
scripts.stop:all: npm run stop:backend && npm run stop:frontend
scripts.stop:backend: powershell -Command "Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000,3001,3002,3003 -State Listen | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Host 'Backend services stopped on ports 3000-3003'"
scripts.stop:frontend: powershell -Command "Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 4000,4001,4002,4003,4004,4005 -State Listen | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Host 'Frontend services stopped on ports 4000-4005'"
scripts.stop:ports: taskkill /F /IM node.exe 2>nul || echo No Node.js processes found
scripts.restart: npm run stop:all && ping 127.0.0.1 -n 3 > nul && npm start
scripts.restart:backend: npm run stop:backend && ping 127.0.0.1 -n 2 > nul && npm run start:backend
scripts.restart:frontend: npm run stop:frontend && ping 127.0.0.1 -n 2 > nul && npm run start:frontend
